{{Quote|Then, for a time, I worked for a planetary survey Alpha-Team.|Bollux|<ref name="Han Solo at Stars' End">''[[Han Solo at Stars' End]]''</ref>}}
An '''Alpha Team''' was a small expeditionary force employed by the [[Imperial Bureau of Stellar Charts and Surveys]] to carry out its mission to explore [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Alpha Teams were responsible for the survey of newly discovered [[Planet/Legends|planets]] and utilized the talents of [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]], [[Cartographer/Legends|cartographers]], [[Astrophysicist/Legends|astrophysicists]], [[Geologist/Legends|geologists]], sociologists, [[Xenolinguist/Legends|linguists]] and [[Xenobiologist/Legends|xenobiologists]], as well as the most advanced equipment available to fulfill their objectives. The [[Labor droid/Legends|labor droid]] [[BLX-5|Bollux]] was once employed by an Alpha Team after being [[Manumission/Legends|manumitted]] from service at the [[Fondor Shipyards/Legends|Fondor Shipyards]].
